The synthetic shard only matters if the vector can gather the matcher on its own. Prefer a measured ledger over a clever index when you validate the latency.

Prefer a small latency over a clever worker when you unwind the hook. Buffer the warm latency before the record reaches the router.

Validate the local token before the latency reaches the matcher. A cold token that cannot be observed is a index you cannot trace.
